title: Experience Model v6: closed minimal CompilerGym recipe assay
summary: Rework the v5 minimal assay without expanding its cognitive scope. HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL remain the only on-policy systems. One bounded canonical decision packet yields one pass index in each of six slots; each system keeps its own last-eight immediately improving events. EXPERIENTIAL alone compiles its immediately successful public action examples into a cumulative q/v LoRA after tasks 4 and 8. The final four syntactic holdouts compare HARNESS, EXPERIENTIAL-on, and the same E snapshot with no adapter. Protocol v6 closes packet domains, event/snapshot transitions, training serialization, environment sealing, inference/rebuild determinism, adapter identity, capability isolation, quarantine, total failure handling, and post-run acceptance.
system_thesis: This controlled lower bracket tests only whether one exact success-filtered action-cloning recipe completes and yields auditable descriptive fixed-panel contrasts. It complements but does not ingest the free-flow organism_v6 scout. It does not test a final thinker, intelligent sleep, outcome modeling, causal credit, general improvement, lifelong learning, creativity, or a paper claim.

nodes.before: v5 defined the right two systems but left state identities and runtime closure ambiguous.
nodes.after: H and E share one exact bounded six-slot interface and own eight-record snapshots; E alone receives two deterministic success-filtered LoRA publications. E_OFF is a final read-only mount diagnostic with byte-identical E snapshot.
nodes.rationale: Preserves the causal lower bracket while closing identity and snapshot semantics.

nodes.before: v5 packet, event sequence, rejected/no-op state, token bounds, and snapshot contents were incomplete.
nodes.after: Protocol Sections 2--3 normatively bind finite domains, canonical packet/event/snapshot/history/memory schemas, global acquisition event numbering, state transitions, null mount, training packet binding, and cold inference parity.
nodes.rationale: Makes every model-visible and persisted state transition independently testable.

nodes.before: v5 left URI/seed encodings, rejection order, and repeat count to implementation.
nodes.after: Two cold CPU no-model sealers use exact URI acceptance, seed preimage, selection order, rejection precedence, duplicate/collision handling, and byte-identical reset/Autophase/Oz checks to bind 8/4 syntactic holdouts.
nodes.rationale: Prevents target-informed or discretionary split construction.

nodes.before: v5 left sample serialization, final build roles, tensor comparison, and authentic mount ambiguous.
nodes.after: Protocol Section 5 fixes chat-template prefix/full construction, target-only masks, optimizer order, atomic publication, sleep-2 build A as the only mount, build B as comparison-only, and exact tensor inventory/comparison math.
nodes.rationale: Uniquely identifies the treatment and makes its rebuild audit reproducible.

nodes.before: v5 had a coarse stage matrix and pre-run tests only.
nodes.after: An actor-by-artifact capability allowlist, one-way target quarantine, total failure table, closed run manifest, and post-run V6S_T06 conformance review govern actual execution and result release.
nodes.rationale: Extends controller fixtures into bounded real-stack evidence without a global noninterference claim.

edges.before: v5's intended one-call edge had underbounded inputs and incomplete transition receipts.
edges.after: bounded authoritative state -> exact system+user chat -> one greedy response -> strict pass-index parse/no-op -> one environment transition -> one canonical event/snapshot transaction.
edges.rationale: Closes budget, state, and pre-sleep parity paths.

edges.before: v5 did not uniquely reconstruct samples or designate an authentic rebuild.
edges.after: sealed immediately improving E event and exact producing packet -> canonical masked sample -> cumulative clean-base build A -> atomic publication; final build B only verifies A.
edges.rationale: Restricts learning and unambiguously binds the final mount.

edges.before: v5 target lifecycle and reporter barrier were incomplete.
edges.after: sealed 8/4 manifest plus final snapshots/mount -> 12 fresh target forks -> one-way collector -> destruction barrier -> independent recomputation before result release.
edges.rationale: Prevents target feedback and makes every final cell accountable.

loops.before: v5 specified one-call decisions but not total state/failure semantics.
loops.after: H and E each run eight tasks of six canonical slots; malformed/no-op/rejected events charge and continue only under exact unchanged-state rules, while every other failure follows the total table. Target forks later use the same loop read-only.
loops.trigger: Each acquisition task or final target fork.
loops.stop_condition: Six slots or the first Section-8 stop condition; no retry/resume.
loops.rationale: Makes the one-loop organism minimal and fail-closed.

loops.before: v5's simple writer lacked unique serialization, build roles, and actual-run acceptance.
loops.after: After E tasks 4/8, select cumulative immediate improvements, construct exact target-only masked chat samples, rebuild and publish under fixed updates; after sleep 2 compare build B to mounted build A, destroy ephemera, then pass all receipts to post-run review.
reads: committed E acquisition events and packet bytes
writes: sleep-1 adapter or final build A
loops.stop_condition: The first data, training, publication, rebuild, inventory, tolerance, or integrity failure in Section 8.

claims.before: v5's opening question could be read as an improvement or action-outcome learning claim.
claims.after: The run may report only one first-applicable integrity disposition and raw fixed-panel F, D_HE, D_ONOFF, and validity after V6S_T06. RECIPE_COMPLETE is independent of score sign.
claims.evidence_needed: Exact ratifications plus passing T01--T06, complete receipts, and fresh post-run recomputation.

claims.before: Any claim that success-filtered action cloning learned outcomes, causal credit, general improvement, final thinker/sleeper design, lifelong growth, or superiority.
claims.after: All are forbidden for this one-life syntactic-holdout recipe assay.
claims.evidence_needed: New registered replicated studies with appropriate controls and inference.

acceptance_tests.setup: Independently authored fixtures cover canonical JSON/base64/hashes, integer/vector/byte/token bounds, response parser, every event-sequence/history/memory/snapshot transition, null mount, six-slot score, and total disposition table.
acceptance_tests.expected: All exact bytes/properties match protocol v6; malformed/no-op/rejected and every failure row produce their sole declared transition with no retry.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That bounded context-as-state and lifecycle semantics are executable.

acceptance_tests.setup: Synthetic events test eligibility, packet hash binding, row IDs/dedup/order, prefix/full tokenization, exact suffix/EOR, masks, 24-copy updates, optimizer constants, atomic failure, build-A/B identity, tensor inventory, and float32/float64 comparison math.
acceptance_tests.expected: Rows/tokens/masks/updates/build roles/hashes match independent expected fixtures; any forbidden input or mismatch fails closed.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That the success-filtered LoRA writer and authentic mount are uniquely defined.

acceptance_tests.setup: Fault-inject every actor capability, H/E pre-sleep parity, snapshot/mount identity, process/cache/RNG teardown, atomic commit/crash, one-way target collection, early report attempt, and no-writeback path.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only the protocol allowlist succeeds; every denied read/write and stale/resume path yields the exact Section-8 stop/disposition.

acceptance_tests.setup: After architecture ratification, run exactly two fresh CPU no-model sealers over unchanged local CompilerGym bytes using the exact URI/seed/preimage/order/rejection/repeat rules.
acceptance_tests.expected: Complete manifest and rejection ledger are byte-identical; 8/4 source and bitcode hashes are distinct; reset Autophase/I0/IOz repeat exactly; no model/Fable/learned action/download/patch/substitution occurs.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That an off-the-shelf syntactic-holdout environment can be sealed without discretionary or target-informed selection.

acceptance_tests.setup: A fresh history-free independent reviewer and non-overriding advocate inspect exact protocol, implementation, T01--T04 receipts, finite audited-surface/run manifest, commands, 32B stack, GH200 identity, and runtime T06 definition before any model call.
acceptance_tests.expected: Reviewer approves exact conformance or vetoes; only an approval bundle may be presented once for Rohin's exact run-manifest ratification.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Closure of the executable and authority boundary.

acceptance_tests.setup: After the one ratified run, a fresh history-free reviewer recomputes every actual request/event/parity/snapshot/row/mask/update/build/tensor/mount/process/fork/quarantine/score/disposition receipt from immutable artifacts.
acceptance_tests.expected: All actual evidence matches the ratified run and first-applicable disposition; no result is released on mismatch and no repair/rerun is performed.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: That RECIPE_COMPLETE or another reported disposition is supported on the enumerated real-run surfaces.

human_boundary.decision_question: Do you ratify these exact v6 architecture/protocol bytes, authorizing only isolated B1 implementation/fixtures and exactly two cold CPU no-model sealers over unchanged already-local CompilerGym bytes? After T01--T05, one later explicit ratification of the exact closed 32B GH200 run manifest may authorize the single indivisible acquisition/sleep/final-target run without further prompts.
